note: Village park on an open grass point at the Lake Pepin shore, across the tracks from downtown, with a sand boat launch and a day-use dock; the electric sites sit toward the woods, the tent sites nearer the water. Portable toilets only. The BNSF main line runs right beside the park, with loud trains through the night. --Claude
summary: Village has no web page; read the community-association recreation page (50-amp sites $25, tents $15, first-come, 'call the Village 715-448-2205') and Travel Wisconsin ($20/$15). 50 amp + FCFS kept (reported); unsourced site count 12 cleared; lakeview kept (open grass ~45 m above the shore across a bank and vegetated flat; site positions unpublished). Phone '' -> 715-448-2205. Fee left: undated, two figures.
flags: FEES: stored $25 (maidenrock.org, read 2026-10-10) left as is, but neither source is the village's own nor dated: the community-association page (not affiliated with the village, (c) 2019) says $25 a day for 50-amp sites, the Travel Wisconsin listing says $20; tent sites $15 in both. No 2024+ operator rate exists online - a call to the village (715-448-2205) would settle it.

WATERFRONT: stored lakeview kept. On zoom-19 imagery the camping area is an open mown grass point (tables/fire rings at about 44.5594,-92.3108) whose south edge drops over a ~1-2 m bank to a vegetated flat; open water of Lake Pepin is ~40-50 m from the tables. Mississippi Valley Traveler puts 'a few primitive sites next to the river, and a few electric sites next to the woods', so the RV (electric) sites are the ones farther back (~60-90 m). No published site numbers or map. A tent-site waterfront would not earn the value for the RV sites; lakeview stands.
